newsitem.title: UK: Scottish Power leads UK utilities higher.
newsitem.headline: Scottish Power leads UK utilities higher.

text.p: British utilities shares forged ahead on Thursday as prices were squeezed higher in relatively thin trade, dealers said.
"People are trying to keep level books and so when wind gets round of an order, the prices get jacked up," one market-maker said.

Scottish Power Plc shares led the advance, up 12-1/2p at 348-1/2 by 1153 GMT. United Utilities was up 5-1/2p at 754-1/2, Scottish Hydro-Electric Plc climbed five pence to 359 and Energy Group Plc firmed 14p to 503-1/2.
Energy Group was helped by Wednesday's upgrade by Goldman Sachs, dealers said.
"Prices have shot up but volumes are pretty thin, it's just a squeeze," another market-maker said.
